name: proofable-mcp
description: Context and control for any AI. Agent identity, scoped access, and proof across tools.

interface.longDescription: Proofable is the trust harness for AI: every agent gets an owner, the limits you set, and a signed receipt of what it did, in the AI tools you already use. Check an agent's permissions before it acts, reuse a proof instead of verifying again, and load an agent's identity, limits and context into your work. Built for small AI teams and builders who let agents do real work. Sign-in is required, and proofs stay offchain unless you ask for a blockchain record.
defaultPrompt: Check what my agents are allowed to do.
Reuse a proof I already have instead of verifying again.
Show my Proofable profile and what it can prove.
